recentItems.title: SpaceX Crew 13 docking at International Space Station
recentItems.description:
A multi-national crew of four is arriving at the International Space Station for a six-month mission aboard the orbiting lab. They took off on Thursday morning and SpaceX Crew 13 is in the process of docking Thursday night. CBS News space consultant Bill Harwood has more about the process.

recentItems.title: Attorney on Christa Pike's botched execution: "The real issue here is that we don't know anything"
recentItems.description:
Death row inmate Christa Pike was scheduled to die by lethal injection on Wednesday night in Tennessee, but the procedure failed and she is still alive. Her attorneys say she is in critical condition and is receiving life-saving medical care. Bo King, the attorney for Brad Sigmon, who was executed by firing squad, joins CBS News to discuss.

recentItems.title: Jane Doe told men she didn't want to continue during alleged gang rape, Cornell Title IX probe shows
recentItems.description:
CBS News New York has obtained documents from Cornell University's Title IX investigation into the alleged 2024 gang rape at a fraternity party. According to those records, Jane Doe said she told the men that she was tired and didn't want to continue, but instead of stopping, she claims she was encouraged to take more substances. CBS News' crime reporter Anna Schecter has more.
